items.title: Kinas spionchef varnar för att AI kan hota kommunistpartiet
items.summary: AI kan hota kommunistpartiets styre och landets säkerhet, varnar chefen för Kinas underrättelsetjänst och efterlyser skarpare regler för att kontrollera tekniken. Samtidigt anklagar Kina de amerikanska teknikchefer som vill dra ned på takten i AI-utvecklingen för skräckpropaganda.

items.title: Sweden and the Netherlands agree on GlobalEye deal
items.summary: Sweden and the Netherlands have signed a Letter of Intent on long-term cooperation regarding airborne warning and control capabilities through the GlobalEye system. The Netherlands intends to acquire one GlobalEye system.

items.title: Government receives new application for financial support for nuclear power project
items.summary: The Government has received another application for state aid to build new nuclear reactors in Sweden. The application was submitted by Blykalla, a company that intends to establish a nuclear power plant in Tierp Municipality, in Uppsala County. This is the sixth such application received by the Government.

items.title: Government receives application for state aid for new nuclear power project
items.summary: The Government has received another application for financial support to build nuclear reactors. The application was submitted by a newly established project company owned by Fortum. This is the fifth state aid application that the Government has received since the state aid programme was launched.
